# FDG5028

> DO provide sensible default values for all properties, ensuring that the defaults do not result in a security hole or terribly inefficient code.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2 Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a default value is sensible, secure and efficient is a matter of judgment.
